text:
alex_sales: Heads up 1 — CoralBay wants a short POC using their own model 'seabright-ozone-13b'. Goal: low-latency chat + retrieval-augmented generation. They asked about compatibility, cost, and timeline. Can SE/infra/security triage?
rina_se: What format did they send? any tokenizer?
alex_sales: Sent a link to a GGUF bundle + tokenizer.json + README. They claim 64k context support.
rina_se: 64k native is ambitious. Our runtime supports up to 65k but depends on kv layout and whether they expect full-context attention all the time. Need to confirm if they use flash-attn style or block-sparse attention. Also check tokenizer: sentencepiece vs bpe.
jordi_infra: Quick infra notes: seabright-ozone-13b @ 4-bit q8-ish + 64k KV is heavy. Rough memory per request ~4-6GB of KV depending on kv packing. Concurrency >4 will push us to multi-node sharded Dedicated. For a small Hosted sandbox we can do single pinned 80GB node but expect latency hit with long contexts.
anika_security: Security checklist: because this is customer-supplied binary we need license provenance and a dependency SCA. Their README says "proprietary with redistribution restrictions"  that's an immediate blocker for Hosted multi-tenant unless we do a legally isolated host and signed agreement. I'll loop Legal.
rina_se: SE plan if legal ok: 1) tokenizer consistency check + adapter if needed (scripts exist), 2) build two variants (4-bit q* and 8-bit), 3) run their eval set (they promised 200 queries) and our baseline comparison, 4) perf sweep with 1/2/4 concurrency and ctx slices (1k/8k/64k). ETA ~4 business days once artifacts are in staging.
alex_sales: They asked about rough price delta for Hosted isolated vs Dedicated week. Also asked if we can avoid model copy for Hosted.
jordi_infra: Pricing ballpark: Hosted isolated sandbox ~= $5,000/day (includes operator on-call + isolated runtime + storage + KMS envelope). Dedicated minimal (2x A100-80GB reserved for a week, no autoscale) ~= $25k-30k/week depending on net egress/KMS. Engineering variant validation fee ~= $2,000 one-time. These are budgetary. Finance will provide formal quote.
anika_security: If they want no copy on our hosts: we can support a VPC-hosted Private with customer-provided NFS or pre-signed s3 and our runtime will stream from there, but legal still wants license/TOU signed. For Hosted we require the model artifact to be staged into an isolated tenant bucket with KMS; we do make a transient copy during the build phase. If that's unacceptable they must go Private. ina_se: (typo fix) — also callout: retrieval path. If their RAG uses external vector DB (e.g., Pinecone/Weaviate) we'll need network egress and an auth token from them. That can add latency and complexity for replaying evals.
alex_sales: Do we have an ops snippet to give them for upload & telemetry?
rina_se: Yes, include this in POC packet:
```
# upload to CoralBay staging (customer):
rw model upload --name seabright-ozone-13b --format gguf --files seabright.gguf tokenizer.json README.md --visibility private --kms arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd

# enable telemetry / eval hook:
rw model attach-eval --name seabright-ozone-13b --evalset s3://coralbay-evals/200-queries.json --notify rina_se
```
jordi_infra: Ops notes: we'll enable KV caching and prefix caching for chat to reduce repeated recompute. For true 64k sessions we recommend explicit session sampling in the client to avoid huge KV growth.
anika_security: Blockers summary for sales email: 1) License prohibits Hosted multi-tenant (Legal sign-off required), 2) 64k native context increases infra footprint (Dedicated likely), 3) External vector DB egress + auth add costs and SSO needs.
alex_sales: Perfect. I'll ping CoralBay to ask them to stage artifacts and share their eval set + licensing doc. Rina, can you start the build when the GGUF lands?
rina_se: Yes. I'll watch the staging bucket and kick off a 4-bit build + baseline run. Will open SE ticket.
ops-bot: Created ticket SE-4682 "CoralBay seabright-ozone POC variant + perf" assigned to rina_se, due 2024-09-02. :gear:
